acceptance: Reproduce the current dry-run for SUP-PROVIDER-REPORT-CALL-SIGNATURE-20260811 / PR #4741 and capture the exact classification input that incorrectly treats the explicitly non-required issuer audit as blocking.

Implement a data-driven required-versus-diagnostic status classifier in auto_integrator. A check may be ignored only when it is positively identified as non-required; missing, ambiguous, required, stale-head, review, trailer, or actual CI failures must continue to block fail closed.
Do not add a broad name-only ignore, direct gh merge bypass, branch-protection change, reviewer impersonation, or canonical task-state workaround.

Add focused regression tests for PR #4741-shaped diagnostic failure, required failure, ambiguous requiredness, failing trailer, canonical review gate, and exact-head drift; update the integrator contract.

Record exact-head evidence. Every new commit subject must be at most 72 characters with required trailers. Deliver through a clean branch, PR, independent exact-head review, required checks, and protected merge.
No live runtime promotion or manual merge is in scope; after merge, the supervisor-owned integrator must perform a fresh governed dry-run and merge attempt.
task_spec.summary: The governed dry-run for PR #4741 fails only because auto_integrator treats the diagnostic check Audit signed canonical review (not required issuer) as a merge-blocking failure. Implement a narrow required-versus-diagnostic check classifier so an explicitly non-required status cannot block a protected merge, while every required, unknown-requiredness, stale-head, review-binding, trailer, or actual CI failure remains fail closed. Source-only; do not direct-merge #4741 or change branch protection.
task_spec.title: Classify optional PR diagnostics without blocking merges
